bugs.bug: lexer.error reports the error on the previous line whenever the lexer is at EOF, so an error at the end of the input (for example a trailing backslash inside a string) gets the wrong line number
bugs.match: errorPrevLine|(atEOF|at EOF|end of (input|file)).{0,100}(previous|prior|preceding) line|(previous|wrong) line.{0,100}(EOF|end of (input|file))
bugs.example: lex.go: error() calls errorPrevLine when lx.atEOF, so any error hit at end of input is attributed to the line before the real one
